patch_description: This ansatz design combines the high-efficiency, symmetric architecture of the "collective mixer" (which uses shared parameters to maintain structural invariance and reduce the search space) with the increased expressivity of individual qubit tuning. By inserting a layer of individual, trainable RX rotations before the collective output mixers, the circuit can learn to apply unique phase corrections to each qubit wire. This breaks the strict symmetry imposed by the purely collective layers, allowing the model to adapt to asymmetric features in the input dataset while maintaining the parameter efficiency of the original design.
